children.name: Text
children.characters: The Build Tool for the Web

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite is a blazing fast frontend build tool powering the next generation of web applications.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Trusted by the world's best software teams

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite makes web development enjoyable again

children.name: Text
children.characters: On demand source file serving over native ESM, with blazing fast dependency pre-bundling.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Instantly reflect changes as you save, no matter how big your app is.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Rich Features Out of the Box

children.name: Text
children.characters: TypeScript, JSX, CSS, Workers, WebAssembly... and more just a plugin away.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Advanced tree-shaking, built-in minification, fine-grained chunking control powered by Rolldown.

children.name: Text
children.characters: A shared foundation to build upon

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite plugins extends Rollup's well-designed plugin interface with a few extra Vite-specific options.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Designed to be built on top of.

children.name: Text
children.characters: It's never been easier to setup custom SSR (Server-Side Rendering), or build your own SSR framework.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Our CI continuously tests Vite changes against downstream projects, allowing us to improve Vite with stability and confidence.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Powering your favorite frameworks and tools

children.name: Text
children.characters: Don't take our word for it - listen to what Vite community members have to say.

children.name: Text
children.characters: I'm loving what Vite enables. We've found building SolidStart that it is less a metaframework but a system of symbiotic Vite plugins. While built with SolidJS in mind, they should scale from our simplest template to opinionated starter. We're building an ecosystem on Vite.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite is basically the united nations of JavaScript at this point. I'll be there as a representative of Sveltelandia

children.name: Text
children.characters: Each and every time I use Vite, I feel a true sense of pure and unbridled joy.

children.name: Text
children.characters: It's also a great platform to build a framework on since it provides a pluggable dev environment.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Every time I suspect I've hit the bounds of what Vite can do, I end up being wrong.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite has been a game changer for the industry.

children.name: Text
children.characters: I am so excited to see so many great frameworks teaming up on top of vite. So many will benefit. ❤️ to the vite team.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite is gonna eat the (JavaScript) world.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, Vite is..... Vite is.... Wow 🤤🤯🙏

children.name: Text
children.characters: Vite is MIT Licensed and will always be free and open source. This is made possible by our contributors and these companies:

children.name: Text
children.characters: Prepare for a development environment that can finally keep pace with the speed of your mind.
